_source.title: 定位到画布区域
_source.remarks.text.0: 本接口在前端画布上定位到指定的区域，区域数据为相对于数据原点的偏移；
_source.remarks.text.1:
例如：传入数据为 `{left: 0, right: 60, top: 100, bottom: -20}` =\> `navigateToRegion(0, 60, 100, -20)`，
则画布将会定位到以 `[30, 40]` 为中心的，`x` 轴方向长度为 `60`，`y` 轴方向长度为 `120` 的矩形范围；
_source.remarks.text.2: 本接口不进行缩放操作，但会生成指示定位中心及表示区域范围的矩形框；
_source.remarks.text.3: 此处的单位为数据层面单位，在跨度上等同于画布层面的 mil
_source.params.left: 矩形框第一 X 坐标
_source.params.right: 矩形框第二 X 坐标
_source.params.top: 矩形框第一 Y 坐标
_source.params.bottom: 矩形框第二 Y 坐标

title: Locate to canvas region
remarks.text.0: This API positions on the front-end canvas to the specified region. The region data is an offset relative to the data origin;
remarks.text.1:
For example: the passed-in data is `{left: 0, right: 60, top: 100, bottom: -20}` => `navigateToRegion(0, 60, 100, -20)`,
then the canvas will be positioned to a rectangular range centered at `[30, 40]` with a length of `60` in the x-axis direction and `120` in the y-axis direction;
remarks.text.2: This API does not perform zooming, but it will generate a rectangle frame indicating the positioning center and the region range;
remarks.text.3: The units here are data-level units, which are equivalent to mil on the canvas level in span
params.left: First X coordinate of the rectangle
params.right: Second X coordinate of the rectangle
params.top: First Y coordinate of the rectangle
params.bottom: Second Y coordinate of the rectangle
